name: westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_status_text_received
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeApiEventSink::OnStatusTextReceived appends carriage-return separated WOL status text lines and signals the status-text event.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The retail function duplicates statusText for strtok and never frees the duplicated buffer; source preserves that leak for behavior and ABI/source-shape fidelity.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/HLIL for 0x43fde0 validates the stdcall three-argument callback shape, negative-status early return, _strdup(statusText), strtok with delimiter "\r", AppendStatusTextFmt for each non-empty token, SetEvent(g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeStatusTextEvent), no free of the duplicated buffer, and return value 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_api_event_sink_on_status_text_received_smoke patches AppendStatusTextFmt and SetEvent, and verifies negative-status no-op behavior, carriage-return line splitting and append order, empty-text event signaling, status-event handle use, and zero return value.
